About ACTS
Asset Conformity Testing Services (ACTS) is an established, NATA-accredited ISO/IEC 17020 inspection body delivering independent asset inspection, testing, and integrity services across the mining and mineral processing, oil and gas, manufacturing, construction, rail, and port sectors. 
We provide practical, innovative, and compliance-focused solutions, including engineering services, third-party inspections, and NDT services, tailored to support our clients’ reliability, safety, and regulatory requirements. 
About the Role
We are looking for a certified and experienced Plant Inspector to join our Perth Inspection Team to conduct Plant inspections throughout Western Australia. You will ideally have experience in a similar inspection role. This is a unique opportunity to be part of a young company and play an important role in our growth journey. 
The role includes FIFO (rostered or project-based) and Perth metro work, based out of our High Wycombe office, Monday to Friday with overtime as required.
You will work alongside project engineers, maintenance teams, HSE personnel and other relevant stakeholders to ensure all plant meets regulatory requirements and industry best practice. API510 or AICIP is essential.
Role Accountabilities
•	Perform inspections, testing, and audits on registered plant, including pressure vessels, cranes, and lifting equipment, using specialist inspection and testing equipment
•	Prepare high-quality inspection and compliance reports tailored to client and regulatory requirements
•	Use knowledge and skills, from qualifications and experience, to assess compliance in accordance with relevant WA legislation and Standards.
•	Liaise with site engineers, supervisors, and maintenance teams to prioritise remedial works.
•	Provide technical support and advice related to compliance matters to clients.
•	Liaise with Department of Mines, Industry Regulation and Safety and Worksafe on client’s registered plant assets.
What we are looking for
Applicants must possess the following:
•	API510 or AICIP Pressure equipment inspection qualifications and relevant experience in the inspections space.
•	Demonstrated experience in the inspection of cranes and lifting equipment.
•	Good understanding of all relevant Australian Standards applicable to the Plant Inspection role in Western Australia.
•	Attention to detail, report writing skills, self-motivated to comply with client reporting timelines.
•	Good written and verbal communication skills.
•	Current WA drivers’ license.
•	Willingness to travel to site as required.
Desirable Criteria
•	AINDT/ PCN/ ISO 9712 NDT qualifications/API 653 certification
•	Experience working with Tier-1 mining operators (Rio Tinto, FMG, BHP or similar)
•	Engineering background, trade qualification, or High-Risk Work Licence
About the position
•	Permanent Full-time position. 
•	Attractive remuneration package aligned with your experience, certifications, and industry standards, including competitive base salary, overtime rates, and FIFO / site allowances where applicable
•	Join an experienced, and supportive team, with genuine opportunities to contribute to and grow with ACTS

•	Exposure to diverse range of projects and clients across the WA resources and other sectors.
Remuneration

Seven Corp on behalf of Reofast


Overview: 

Reofast supplies, fabricates and installs reinforcing steel for premium residential builders across Perth, taking projects from take-off and quotation through to fabrication, delivery and installation. The business is committed to delivering high-quality reinforcement solutions through accuracy, efficiency and exceptional customer service.

We are seeking an experienced Construction Estimator to join our team in Perth, WA. In this role, you will be responsible for analysing structural and architectural drawings, preparing quantity take-offs and cost estimates, and developing reinforcement schedules and bar lists to support the accurate supply, fabrication and delivery of reinforcement steel products. This is a full-time ongoing position working 38 hours per week.


Main tasks:

-	Analysing structural and architectural drawings to determine reinforcement steel requirements for construction projects.
-	Preparing detailed quantity take-offs and cost estimates for steel supply, fabrication and delivery.
-	Developing reinforcement schedules and bar lists to ensure quantities align with structural and engineering drawings.
-	Preparing pricing breakdowns for materials, fabrication and logistics to support quotations and tender submissions.
-	Coordinating with structural engineers, architects, builders, site teams and suppliers to confirm project requirements, quantities and pricing.
-	Reviewing project variations and updating estimates, quantities and costs accordingly.
-	Preparing marked-up drawings and maintaining accurate estimating information across internal software systems.
-	Managing workload, priorities and deadlines to ensure quotations and reinforcement schedules are completed on time.
-	Liaising with clients and builders to ensure estimating is based on the latest project documentation.
-	Monitoring stock levels and assisting with supplier orders as required.
-	Maintaining accurate estimating records and reports.
-	Performing any additional duties as required from time to time.


Required/Relevant Qualifications & Work Experience:

-	Relevant qualification in Construction, Building, Engineering or a related discipline.
-	Alternatively, at least five years of relevant construction estimating experience may substitute for the formal qualification.


Required/Relevant Skills & Knowledge:

-	Strong communication skills with clients, staff and site tradespersons.
-	High attention to detail and accuracy.
-	Ability to read and interpret structural and architectural drawings.
-	Sound understanding of construction site operations and project requirements.
-	Ability to prepare accurate reinforcement schedules within required timeframes.
-	Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage priorities, workloads and deadlines.
-	Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with clients and suppliers.
-	Solutions-focused with a proactive and can-do attitude.
-	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Notion and Slack.
-	Ability to maintain accurate estimating records and reports.


 Annual salary will be between $90,000.00 to $110,000.00 (plus superannuation) depending on level of experience.
